Initially named <var>naked7b2</var>, <var>CMT3</var> was released in 2002 by {{player|Baby Roo|flag=se}} as a part of the [[Custom Map Tournament]] project, springing from a team of mappers lead by {{player|Link|flag=no}} from [[Challenge Smackdown]] Map Development department.

The map had groundbreaking textures for its era, and was made purely for 4on4. 

The idea for the map sprung out of <var>naked6</var>, a map in {{player|Baby Roo|flag=se}}s <var>naked</var> series.

==Trivia==
* Created with Worldcraft 1.6 
* The CMT-logo that can be seen on the map is made by {{player|Zaka|flag=fi}}.
